signature.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
signature.detail: The city's most famous attraction, a large amusement park known for its thrill rides and animal exhibits. It is a full-day outing, so arrive at opening to beat the queues. Buy tickets online in advance for a lower price and to skip the ticket line.

signature.name: The Florida Aquarium
signature.detail: A top family draw on the downtown waterfront with marine life exhibits and hands-on experiences. Go on a weekday morning for smaller crowds. It sits near the Tampa Riverwalk, so pair the visit with a walk along the water.

signature.name: Tampa Riverwalk
signature.detail: A scenic waterfront path linking downtown's museums, parks and the aquarium. It is free and best walked in the cooler early morning or at sunset. Wear comfortable shoes and bring water, as the Florida heat builds by midday.

signature.name: Ybor City
signature.detail: The historic old town district with brick streets and a lively evening scene. Come in the late afternoon to explore before dinner. It is a short ride from downtown, so plan transport back if you stay late.

signature.name: Tampa Museum of Art
signature.detail: A downtown art museum on the Riverwalk with a strong collection and rotating exhibitions. Check opening days before you go, as many museums close one day a week. It is an easy stop while walking the Riverwalk.

signature.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
signature.detail: A well-regarded zoo with a focus on wildlife and family-friendly exhibits. Visit in the morning when animals are most active and the heat is milder. Buy tickets online ahead of time.

transport: Rideshare across downtown $10-20; limited rail, so plan on cars
